plurals.name: web_oidc_passkeys_unlinked
plurals.item: %1$d account isn\'t linked to %2$s, so it can\'t sign in while passkeys are off. While still signed in, it can link %2$s under Settings → Account.
%1$d accounts aren\'t linked to %2$s, so they can\'t sign in while passkeys are off. While still signed in, they can link %2$s under Settings → Account.

resources.string: Anyone who can reach this server can create an account with a passkey. While this is off, a new person needs an invite link from Settings → Users.

plurals.name: web_oidc_ssoOnly
plurals.item: %1$d account signs in only through %2$s. It can\'t sign in again until this is back on.
%1$d accounts sign in only through %2$s. They can\'t sign in again until this is back on.

resources.string: Overrides MATINEE_OIDC_ISSUER_URL. Changing it unlinks every linked account.
Changing it later unlinks every linked account.
Use the secret from the environment
The environment\'s secret applies after you save.
The secret is removed when you save.

The claim that lists an account\'s groups at the provider. At each sign-in, an access group holds the accounts in the provider group named in its settings. An account without the claim is in no provider groups.
The claim that holds one account\'s limits, an object with any of libraries, maxBitrate, transcode, downloads, and maxStreams. At each sign-in it replaces what\'s set on the account under Users.
Sign out accounts the provider refuses

Ends every session of an account once the provider refuses to renew its sign-in, as it does for one it disabled or deleted. This reaches only accounts with a refresh token, which takes the offline_access scope.
Separated by spaces. Must include openid.
